description: Assigns each lat/lon point to its containing polygon from a GeoJSON boundary file, then aggregates specified metrics by polygon. Use to roll up student home addresses by county/district for equity analysis, map alumni giving by congressional district, or aggregate research site observations by administrative boundary. The boundary GeoJSON must be stored in S3.

boundary_uri.description: S3 path to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of polygons (e.g. s3://my-bucket/counties.geojson)

metric_columns.description: Numeric columns to aggregate by polygon

agg_functions.description: Aggregation functions to apply: count, mean, sum, median, min, max

label_column.description: GeoJSON feature property to use as the polygon label (default: 'name')
